title: Demand is strongly seasonal during inferred operating periods
evidence: The strongest operating months are 2025-08, 2024-08, 2024-07 (93.4%, 93.3%, 92.9%); the weakest active months are 2025-05, 2026-05, 2025-09.
business_implication: Use separate high-season yield and shoulder-season volume strategies; do not treat closed months as zero-demand inventory.

title: Revenue scale and pricing power sit in different rooms
evidence: Appartamento Area Giardino leads reliable room revenue at €1,005,415, while Camera Deluxe leads operating RevPAR at €165. The highest observed ADR is Suite Familiare Vista Piscina at €296 (29 bookings); the highest reliable ADR is Villino Double at €248.
business_implication: Use total revenue to understand scale, and ADR/RevPAR to understand pricing power and inventory productivity.

title: Early-booking demand is concentrated and more predictable in the strongest lead-time room
evidence: Appartamento Area Giardino books 83 days ahead versus a reliable-room weighted average of 60 days, with cancellation 13.0% versus 20.3%.
business_implication: Review pricing earlier for rooms that combine long lead time with lower cancellation risk.

title: Cancellation changes the quality of apparent demand
evidence: Appartamento Area Giardino has the lowest reliable cancellation rate at 13.0%, 7.2 percentage points below the reliable-room average.
business_implication: Use retained demand, not gross bookings alone, when interpreting saturation and pickup.

title: Commercial treatment economics are concentrated
evidence: Mezza Pensione and Pensione Completa generate 92.3% of comparable treatment revenue. Mezza Pensione ADR is €209 versus €189, with cancellation 18.9% versus 22.9%.
business_implication: Prioritize pricing and conversion tests on treatments that combine meaningful volume with strong economics.

title: Room conversion varies materially across quoted solutions
evidence: Among rooms with 30+ quoted requests, Appartamento Area Giardino converts 3.3% of quoted requests to the same room, versus Suite Familiare Vista Piscina at 0.9%.
business_implication: Treat room-level conversion as a demand-quality signal: high conversion can support firmer pricing, while low conversion needs diagnosis before price increases.

title: Some rooms combine conversion with premium economics
evidence: Appartamento Area Giardino combines same-room conversion of 3.3% with ADR €158 and operating RevPAR €103.
business_implication: Rooms that sustain both conversion and premium economics are the strongest candidates for protecting or cautiously increasing price.

title: Treatment demand differs in actual conversion, not only revenue
evidence: Bed & Breakfast has the highest reliable same-treatment conversion at 3.7% across 1149 quoted requests.
business_implication: Use treatment conversion together with ADR and revenue per booking to distinguish popular offers from merely high-volume offers.

title: Conversion changes with booking window
evidence: The highest-converting lead-time band is 0-7 days at 8.0%, versus 61-90 days at 2.2%.
business_implication: Use lead-time conversion with occupancy and booking pace when deciding whether to push price or protect volume.

title: The funnel loses most demand after quotation
evidence: Of 29,195 requests, 83.8% receive a quote but only 3.1% are matched to confirmed bookings.
business_implication: Conversion deserves the same monitoring priority as occupancy and booking window; however, the request-to-booking link remains a proxy.

title: Cancellation risk peaks in a core arrival month
evidence: The highest cancellation rate among months with 30+ bookings is 2025-08 at 28.1%.
business_implication: Discount gross demand by month-specific cancellation risk before using it as a pricing trigger.

title: Historical booking pace is a baseline, not yet a live signal
evidence: Average completed-stay booking shares range from 3.6% to 72.9% across lead-time checkpoints.
business_implication: Store recurring snapshots before interpreting deviations as acceleration or slowdown.

title: Room-category occupancy contains capacity conflicts
evidence: The historical reconstruction contains 423 room-type/date rows above current catalogue capacity.
business_implication: Treat property-level occupancy as more reliable than room-category occupancy until historical capacity and reassignment logic are confirmed.

title: Aggregate room booking windows hide large seasonal shifts
evidence: Appartamento Area Giardino has a 139-day spread between its shortest and longest reliable monthly booking-window averages.
business_implication: Use room-and-period-specific lead-time curves instead of one all-season room average when deciding how early pricing should react.

title: Room RevPAR leadership changes by stay period
evidence: The strongest reliable room-month RevPAR is Appartamento Area Piscina in 2024-08 at €294.
business_implication: Monitor room productivity by stay period; an all-season RevPAR average can hide where pricing power is strongest.

title: Room conversion depends on both stay period and booking window
metric: conversion × room × year × season × booking window
evidence: The strongest sufficiently observed same-room conversion is Appartamento Area Giardino, 2025-09, 0-7: 24.2% across 33 quoted requests.
business_implication: Read conversion in its room, stay-period and lead-time context before treating it as upward or downward pricing pressure.

title: Treatment booking behaviour changes through the season
evidence: Mezza Pensione has a 59-day spread between its shortest and longest reliable monthly booking-window averages.
business_implication: Evaluate treatment pricing and demand by stay period rather than relying on one all-season treatment average.

title: Treatment acceptance changes by season and booking window
metric: conversion × treatment × year × season × booking window
evidence: The strongest sufficiently observed same-treatment conversion is Mezza Pensione, 2025-09, 0-7: 29.2% across 65 quoted requests.
business_implication: Validate treatment price and packaging in the specific stay-period and booking-window context where customers actually accept it.
